text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It is not just about reading words; it also involves grasping meaning, context, and even emotion. This technology powers many everyday tools. For example, online translation services can instantly convert a sentence from English to Spanish. Sentiment analysis is another key use, allowing companies to scan customer reviews to see if the overall mood is positive or negative. Finally, chatbots rely heavily on NLP to have simple conversations with users, answering questions or providing support. Thanks to these advances, machines are becoming much better at interacting with us naturally.
